findings.title: No test for a negative baseline
findings.detail: Spec R4 allows negative values but every test uses a positive `old`; percent_change(-100, -50) == -0.5 is unproven. Add one assertion with a negative baseline.

findings.title: Docstring could show the decrease example
findings.detail: Stating `percent_change(200, 150) == -0.25` in the docstring makes the sign convention unambiguous for readers.

findings.title: test_exported could also assert callability
findings.detail: `callable(calc.percent_change)` is a cheap extra assertion; not required.

findings.title: Match the ValueError message
findings.detail: `pytest.raises(ValueError, match="non-zero")` pins the message the spec names.

findings.title: __all__ ordering
findings.detail: `__all__` is alphabetical; keep it that way when the next function lands.
